questions.question: How far should this detailed plan drive the build?

options.label: P1+P2+P3 (full MVP)
options.description: Eval UI + recommend engine + radar/preset viz. The plan's stated MVP+1day. Best fit for a parallel subagent build.

options.label: P1+P2 only
options.description: Eval UI + recommend engine. Minimal usable MVP, defer visualization.

options.label: P1 only
options.description: Just the evaluation UX (cards/search/filter/tier/localStorage). Single track, little parallelism.

options.label: Through P4
options.description: Everything incl. tier dragboard, share-URL, image self-hosting. Largest fan-out.

questions.question: How should the plan structure parallel execution?

options.label: Workflow + worktrees
options.description: Deterministic Workflow script: scaffold → fan out logic/eval-UI/viz subagents in git worktrees → integration agent wires App.tsx. Max parallelism.

options.label: Manual parallel subagents
options.description: I describe which subagents to deploy in parallel (single message, multiple Agent calls) at execute time, without a Workflow script.

options.label: Sequential, no subagents
options.description: Plain phased checklist I execute top-to-bottom myself. Simplest, slowest.

options.label: Hotlink dodo.ac (MVP)
options.description: Use the precomputed dodo.ac URLs already in villagers.json. Zero extra work; defer self-hosting to P4.

options.label: Self-host now
options.description: Add the build-script download step to vendor all 391 images into public/. More work, no external CDN dependency.

questions.question: 어떤 언어를 지원할까요? (ACNHAPI 원본은 다국어 이름을 모두 보유)

options.label: 한/영/일
options.description: KRko·USen·JPja. 가장 흔한 모동숲 사용권. 데이터·UI 번역량 적당.

options.label: 주요 6개국
options.description: 한·영·일·중(간체)·프·독. 커버리지 넓고 빌드스크립트로 일괄 추출.

options.label: ACNHAPI 전체
options.description: 원본 제공 14개 로케일 전부. 최대 커버리지, UI 문자열 번역 부담 큼.

options.label: 한/영
options.description: 현 데이터 그대로(추가 추출 불필요). 언어 전환 UI만 추가.

options.label: 자동감지 + 수동전환
options.description: 브라우저 navigator.language로 초기 로케일 자동 선택 + 수동 스위처. localStorage에 선호 저장. '국가별 맞춤'에 부합.

options.label: 수동전환만
options.description: 기본 한국어 + 드롭다운 수동 전환. 자동감지 없음. 단순.
